about: compute_retention_mask on bf16 embeddings [t][h*w][hidden]; bits are bf16 as little-endian u16; dissim is the score tensor [t][h*w] (first tubelet 255); masks per rate: keep count and the LSB-first bitmap of t*h*w flags. A recipe case is regenerated from its recipe (tools/nemotron_omni/gen_video_fixture.py: recipe_bits) and checked against bits_sha256.
